notes: Contract 11 freezes SAFETY_FACTOR = 1.25 and FINAL_TRANSFER_RESERVE = 1200 s. This file is the single authoritative home of those constants; campaign/affordability.py refuses to load a policy in which they were altered.
Admission rule: projected_stage_seconds * safety_factor + remaining_reserve <= remaining_authorized.

BENCH is the ONE stage whose projection cannot be measured (it is the measurement). It is admitted against the DECLARED bounded budget bench_declared_budget_seconds and is itself bounded by that budget; every later stage is projected from BENCH's measured numbers.

FULL_MODEL_MODE eligibility: projected_core_comparison_seconds(FULL, U=600 updates/arm, grid + 3 arms + evals) * safety_factor + final transfer reserve <= available_foundation_learner_seconds; otherwise PEFT_MODE for all core arms. U is then the largest ladder value satisfying the same inequality for the selected scope.

This policy is SEPARATE from the O1 runner/budget.py policy, which hard-asserts the O1 45/40/5 split and cannot be reused. The USD 45.00 total session budget remains authoritative at SESSION level and is recorded here for that reason only; nothing in the FL package spends money or contacts a provider.
Rental confirmation remains NOT AUTHORIZED. The transfer/termination reserve is never consumed by a stage.
O1 has absolute priority: FL time only begins after the O1 records are verified, transferred, and the O1 process closed (contract 13).

Stage watchdog (Amendment 12): a running stage is ABORTED when its elapsed time exceeds max(projected_stage_seconds * safety_factor, stage_watchdog_minimum_seconds), or as soon as the remaining authorized time would fall to the final transfer reserve. The minimum floor exists because a projection derived from a short BENCH probe cannot bound a stage below its own measurement noise; the reserve condition is the hard money guarantee and has no floor.
